notes: All six pages are Purdue Krannert 'Distinguished PhD Alum' single-person profiles captured by Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2013-20 (sourceUrl = the index lookup address from each file's footer; sourceDate = capture timestamp date from the file name). Each yields one record with the current title/institution shown on the profile as destination/position; these are later-career affiliations as of 2013, NOT first placements, and no graduation year is given (listedYear null, yearMeaning 'unstated'). Program recorded as 'Krannert School of Management' because the page only says 'Distinguished PhD Alum - Purdue Krannert'; the department/field (e.g. management, economics, information systems, operations) is not stated. Institution abbreviations (MSU, UIUC, Caltech) are kept as written. The sidebar 'Graduate profiles 2013 / 2012' name lists in every snapshot are alumni-site navigation for graduate (non-doctoral) profile pages with no degree, program or placement stated, so they were not recorded; the Michael Shaw capture shows an older sidebar without year headings. The page URL in the chunk for Karel Cool and Nicholas Petruzzi differs only in host/case from the footer 'page' address; the footer index-lookup address was used.
